title: Taylor University (Taylor)
summary: Taylor University (Taylor) is a university in Upland. This entry compiles College Scorecard figures and related sources; UniRepository is not affiliated with Taylor.

sections.heading: What Taylor is known for
paragraphs: Taylor University (Taylor) is a private nonprofit institution with an undergraduate enrollment of approximately 2,025 students. The university has an admission rate of about 73.53%, indicating a moderately selective admissions process. Taylor is known for its diverse academic offerings, with a notable emphasis on business programs, which constitute roughly 13.7% of the total program share. Additionally, health-related programs make up around 1.37% of the academic offerings. These figures highlight Taylor's focus on providing education in business and health fields among its various programs.

sections.heading: How to read Taylor tuition
paragraphs: Taylor University (Taylor) charges a tuition fee of $40,490 for both in-state and out-of-state students. This uniform tuition rate applies regardless of residency status. The total cost of attendance, which includes tuition along with additional expenses such as room, board, and fees, amounts to $53,405. Understanding these figures helps prospective students and their families plan for the financial commitment associated with attending Taylor.

paragraphs: Taylor University (Taylor) provides financial aid options to assist students in managing the cost of attendance.
